methodologyNotes: Covers soft-sided (flexible-shell) personal and day coolers sold at a published US MSRP, including tote, shoulder-sling, and backpack carry styles. Excludes hard-sided rotomolded coolers, wheeled/hard hybrid coolers, lunch boxes without closed-cell insulation, and hard-shell zipperless cube coolers. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. canCapacity is the manufacturer-stated number of 12 fl oz cans WITHOUT ice. volumeLiters is stated interior capacity in liters. emptyWeightLbs is empty weight in pounds. dimensionsInches is external size as 'L x W x H' in inches. iceRetentionHrs is the manufacturer-claimed ice-retention duration in hours; null if not disclosed. closureType is an enum of waterproof-zipper | standard-zipper | roll-top | drawstring. exteriorDenier is the denier (D) rating of the primary exterior fabric; null if not disclosed. leakproof is a boolean: true only if the manufacturer rates the closure leakproof or fully waterproof. carryStyle is an enum of tote | shoulder-sling | backpack | handheld. warrantyYears is the warranty length in years; null if a lifetime warranty or if not disclosed.
